exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: five selected comic panels in one deterministic sequence sheet for CH01 CH01-S03
Primary request: Create a text-free 3-by-2 comic grid. The first five cells are the chronological story sequence below. The sixth cell is a quiet environment-only aftermath motif, never a duplicate character panel.
Scene/backdrop: tram span over South Hook in Veyr, a gravity-rationed city built beside a continent-high vertical ocean.
Characters: Mae Nox, fictional adult woman age 41, tall and broad-shouldered, dark brown skin, one blunt black wedge braid to shoulder blades, ochre work coat, teal rope harness, heavy split-toe boots, practical mature proportions; Dax Pell, fictional adult man age 38, lean, copper-brown skin, silver-black asymmetrical curl crest leaning left, narrow moustache, coral half-cape, charcoal wrap trousers, yellow barometer gauntlet, practical mature proportions.
Non-human subjects: none.
Style/medium: pressure-print comic: bold woodcut-like dry-brush black edges, flat imperfect off-register oxidized teal, warning coral and acid-yellow risograph inks on warm fibrous paper; angular adult proportions, large readable hands, graphic negative-space force paths, simplified backgrounds except for functional machinery, one dominant value break per cell.
Color palette: soot black, oxidized teal, warning coral, warm paper.
Composition/framing: exact clean 3-column by 2-row grid with strong black gutters; one readable moment per cell; varied camera distance; phone-readable silhouettes; the first five cells must read left-to-right top row then left-to-right bottom row.
Chronological cells:
Cell 1: Establish tram span over South Hook; show mae, dax, fictional_adult_passengers; make geography and current load direction obvious.
Cell 2: Intent: stop the tram from falling sideways into the wall-sea; show the responsible adult initiating a concrete step.
Cell 3: Constraint becomes physical and visible: brake teeth cannot engage under lateral load.
Cell 4: Causal action: Mae loops the tow line around a stone rib while Dax vents the tram sail; show footing, contact, rope or mechanism tension, and force direction.
Cell 5: Consequence and remaining state: the rib cracks but the tram swings into a survivable arc; nothing resets between cells.
Irreversible state already in force: official_forecast_disproved, mae_accepts_dax_forecast.
New state that must visibly persist after this sequence: south_hook_rib_cracked.
Lettering clearance: cell 1 reserve normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.4, 0.18] as low-detail negative space; cell 2 reserve normalized rectangle [0.56, 0.06, 0.95, 0.2] as low-detail negative space; cell 3 reserve normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.06, 0.42, 0.2] as low-detail negative space; cell 4 reserve normalized rectangle [0.66, 0.72, 0.94, 0.9] as low-detail negative space; cell 5 reserve normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.3, 0.17] as low-detail negative space.
Constraints: all humans are explicitly fictional adults with unambiguously mature proportions and practical non-sexualized clothing; exact named-character hair, silhouette, wardrobe damage, injuries and equipment persist; coherent anatomy; readable hands; visible physical cause and effect; no spontaneous healing; no extra people unless the cell explicitly calls for a fictional-adult crowd; no glamor posing.
Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, speech balloons, sound-effect text, logos, signatures, watermarks, floating UI, children, child-coded features, young-looking adults, sexual content, gratuitous gore, real-person likeness, third-party characters, named-artist imitation, glossy 3D, soft clear-line watercolor.
